correctness.rationale: For X8 with N(s,t)=max(|s|,|t|,(|s|+|t|)/sqrt2), p>=1 and a=sqrt2-1, Fu--Li ball reduction and separate convexity reduce to 8² ordered vertex pairs. Independent enumeration yields only shifted-norm patterns (2,0), (2,2a), (sqrt2,sqrt2). The three normalized values are 1,1+a^p,2^(1-p/2); Jensen on 1,a, using 1+a=sqrt2, proves 1+a^p>=2^(1-p/2) (strict p>1). For 1<p<2 comparison with the published unrestricted 2^(2-p)(1+a^q)^(p-1), q=p/(p-1)>p, is strictly larger by norm equivalence with unequal nonzero entries. At p=2 both equal 4-2sqrt2; for p>=2 published unrestricted upper bound and vertex witness sandwich to equality. No claim for p<1. Exact octagon finite orbits are exhaustively reconstructed (not extrapolated from numerical sampling); exponent inequality follows analytically.
